purpose: Freeze Campaign139's only candidate, accepted source fingerprints, point-in-time join, event support, no-return gates, development folds, costs and closed stress interval before any Campaign139 source row or value is opened.

point_in_time_limitations: Both inputs are current public historical-event snapshots rather than exchange-grade immutable revision archives.
The quarterly snapshot conservatively keeps the earliest currently visible notice per instrument/report period, but later corrections may have changed the value now visible.
The forecast snapshot may omit or revise history; this campaign makes no pristine point-in-time claim.

candidate.name: quarterly_realized_profit_growth_forecast_surprise_rank
candidate.join_rule: For each realized key, retain finite forecast rows whose announcement_date is strictly earlier than the realized announcement_date and choose the maximum forecast announcement_date.
candidate.duplicate_rule: Exact semantic duplicates may collapse. More than one distinct forecast value at the chosen latest key or more than one distinct realized value/announcement tuple per realized key fails closed.
candidate.score_formula: On each signal session, compute pandas-compatible average-tie percentile ranks over finite live raw surprises after every quality/listing gate.
candidate.availability_rule: First accepted local session strictly after the realized announcement_date.
candidate.same_signal_session_collision_rule: For one instrument, keep the latest effective event, then later report_date, only when its realized key is unique and valid.
candidate.event_expiry_rule: A candidate is live only when signal_date minus effective_date is an integer from zero through three calendar days; no later forward fill.
candidate.missing_and_invalid_rule: Require matching instrument/report_date, strict prior forecast timing and both finite percentage-point values. Never fill, clip, winsorize, offset, divide, bucket, threshold, backfill or substitute another report period.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: source_schema_fingerprint_join_and_duplicate_semantics
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Revalidate every bound source/manifest/calendar/universe hash and exact projection. Reject malformed dates, non-quarter report dates, mismatched keys, nonfinite values, non-prior forecasts, conflicting duplicates and signal dates outside 2019-2023 before publishing a factor frame.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: quality_listing_event_capacity
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Apply the frozen quarterly-quality eligibility and 20 accepted-session listing gate before ranking. On the frozen non-overlapping three-signal-session grid require at least six finite names, two distinct raw surprises, 200 complete cohorts and all five development years.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: ordered_numeric_uniqueness
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Only after capacity passes, load all 141 frozen direction-normalized numeric comparators in exact order. For each comparator require at least six pairwise names on each qualifying event session and at least 100 pairwise sessions; every strict absolute median daily average-tie Spearman correlation must be below 0.8. Insufficient overlap fails closed.

development_contract_if_all_no_return_ga.label_containment: Both t+1 entry and t+3 exit must remain inside the same partition.
development_contract_if_all_no_return_ga.survivor_rule: Use the unchanged repository association, normalized-return, Top3 pilot, affordability, participation, drawdown, fold-consistency and aggregate 20bp gates; no gate may be changed after values.

locked_stress_contract.opening_rule: May be opened once for the whole frozen campaign only after a nonzero 2019-2023 survivor record and a separate immutable stress-opening record.

next_action: Implement and test the pure formula and a zero-value binding validator, freeze their hashes, then run plan. Source columns remain closed until the plan is ready with exit code zero.
